title: Nx Plugin V2 And Atomic Custom Plugin Relocation
description:
This is step M2 of the "mechanism wave" (W4) in the approved plan `/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-codebase-still-has-spicy-umbrella.md` — read it in full first, especially "Mechanism changes" Step 2 and the M2 bullet under "W4 — Mechanism wave", plus "Hard ordering constraints" C2 ("M2 before W9 sweep; .mjs destination final") and Top risk #3 ("nx.json/.mjs atomicity failure kills the nx graph → solo agent, one edit, in-run nx graph smoke, standby fix"). THIS IS EXPLICITLY FLAGGED AS THE SINGLE RISKIEST ATOM IN THE ENTIRE MULTI-WEEK PLAN — read that risk section carefully and follow its mitigation exactly.

CONTEXT — read in full, in this order:
1. The spicy-umbrella plan file above.
2. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md` — the master tracking doc for the whole initiative, read in FULL for prior lessons and current state (all 32 plugins + demonstrator done; M1's taxonomy vocabulary/discovery library just landed at `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️library/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/{🔣️taxonomy.json,🟦️discovery.ts}` — you may read and reference these but the registry/root-policy refactors that consume them are separate future tickets, not yours).
3. `nx.json` at repo root — find the two custom nx plugin `.mjs` files it references by literal path.
4. The two `.mjs` files themselves, read in full.

YOUR TASK: 
1. Default project `cwd` to the project root and default executor where the current nx plugin logic doesn't already do this cleanly; synthesize the "leveled test targets" convention consistently (read existing project.json files to understand today's convention before changing anything).
2. Move BOTH custom nx plugin `.mjs` files to their FINAL destination in the repo-product's `📚️library/` owner root (this must be the location W8d's future Go-split work will also use — check the plan's W8d section for what that owner-root path will eventually be, and land the .mjs files there now so they never move again).
3. Update `nx.json`'s literal path reference(s) to the new location IN THE SAME ATOMIC CHANGE — never leave nx.json pointing at a stale path even transiently.
4. Immediately after the move+repoint, run `bun nx show projects | wc -l` and compare the count to what it was BEFORE your change (capture the before-count first, as your very first action, before touching anything) — if it changes even slightly, STOP, treat it as a red alert, and diagnose/fix before doing anything else (do not proceed to other work with a broken nx graph). Also run `bun nx graph --file=/dev/null` or equivalent to confirm the graph itself still resolves.
5. Delete any dead duplicate function you find in the nx plugin files (the plan mentions one exists) — confirm it's actually dead (no call sites) before removing.
6. nx.json hygiene: remove the stale `cpp` namedInput glob if you confirm it's unused, and check `workspaceLayout` for correctness against the new .mjs location.

CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable):
- This is a SOLO task — do not parallelize sub-pieces, since a broken nx.json mid-edit would corrupt everyone else's tooling. Make the .mjs move + nx.json repoint as ONE atomic edit sequence with the verification smoke test immediately after, before moving to any other step.
- Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, registry generated output, .vscode/launch.json, package.json workspaces, .storybook, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, any plugin directory, or the taxonomy vocabulary/discovery files from M1 (read-only for you).
- Never run git-modifying commands or use git worktrees.
- Do NOT use `run_in_background: true` for Bash — run synchronously with generous timeouts.
- If the project count changes or the graph fails to resolve after your edit, immediately revert your own edit (you may edit files you just created/moved — this is not a git revert, just undoing your own uncommitted change) and re-diagnose before retrying. Do not leave the nx graph broken under any circumstance, even temporarily across tool calls in this session.
- Add temporary files to your own ticket folder.
- When finished (nx graph verified healthy), call `mcp__repo__ticket_close` on your own ticket's exact path with a full summary and file list. Do not touch any other ticket.

Report back a concise summary of what moved, the before/after project counts, and graph-health verification.
summary:
M2 (W4 mechanism wave) complete: nx plugin v2 + atomic custom-plugin relocation.

MOVE (atomic, copy-verify-delete per plan protocol): both custom nx plugins moved from `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️library/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/` to the final `📚️library/` owner root — `🟨️nx-plugin.mjs` and `🟨️nx-emoji-project-plugin.mjs`. nx.json's two literal plugin paths were repointed in ONE edit; copies were verified byte-identical (cmp) and the harness re-run BEFORE the old copies were deleted, so nx.json never pointed at a missing file. This is W8d's final home — the Go split will not move them again (plan line 165).

CRITICAL PRE-EXISTING FINDING — the "before" baseline was ALREADY BROKEN, so the ticket's before/after project-count smoke test was not usable as specified. `nx show projects` exited 1 with zero projects listed for two reasons, neither mine: (1) `@repo/policy-scripts-file` aborted the whole graph with ENOENT on files that demonstrably exist; (2) duplicate project name `os-hub` defined in both `🌎️hub/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust` and `🌎️hub/📦️packages/🦀️rust` — another agent's live W8a hub migration (files timestamped minutes before/during this session).

ROOT CAUSE of (1), diagnosed to the byte level: nx's native file walker hands plugins path strings with lossy U+FFFD (efbfbd) substitutions replacing valid multi-byte emoji/VS16 sequences — verified the on-disk names are VALID UTF-8 via readdirSync with buffer encoding, and captured the corrupted hex from nx itself. Not a repo bug, not a cache bug (survives `nx reset` and NX_DAEMON=false), and nondeterministic — a different path corrupts on each run. It also hits nx's OWN bundled `nx/js/dependencies-and-lockfile` plugin, so it is unfixable from our side. Fixed our exposure by making the plugin skip unreadable files (`readTextOrNull`) instead of aborting the graph; confirmed BEHAVIOUR-NEUTRAL because neither affected script exports a `policy`. Also hardened the emoji plugin against malformed/half-written `📋️project.json` (JSON.parse now guarded) — valuable under concurrent editing.

PLUGIN V2: default executor `nx:run-commands`; default `options.cwd` to the project root; synthesize leveled `test-quick`/`test-long`/`test-exhaustive` from a base `test` target. IMPORTANT correction made during implementation: a blanket cwd default REGRESSED `repo-mcp`, whose 4 test targets deliberately omit cwd so nx's workspace-root default invokes the ROOT `📜️script.ts` (that project root has no script.ts). Refined the rule to apply cwd only when the project root actually owns a `📜️script.ts`, which encodes the repo's real convention and leaves delegating projects correct.

DEAD CODE: removed the duplicate `emojiProjectJsonNodes` from `🟨️nx-plugin.mjs` — confirmed dead by repo-wide grep (defined once, zero call sites; the live copy is in the emoji plugin).

NX.JSON HYGIENE: removed the stale `cpp` namedInput (globs point at a nonexistent `elements/client/lib/geometry/topologic` path; verified 0 references across all 256 project.json inputs arrays and nx.json targetDefaults — the `cpp*` TARGETS in root project.json are unrelated and untouched; root CMakeLists.txt/CMakePresets.json exist so they stay in sharedGlobals). Removed the vestigial `workspaceLayout` (appsDir/libsDir both "compose") — it only affects `nx generate` scaffolding, no generators are used anywhere in the repo, and it contradicted the owner-tree architecture.

VERIFICATION (count smoke test replaced with a stronger, churn-immune method). Because the repo is being edited live by at least three other agents (hub migration, ◻2d module migration, M6 workspaces generator — all observed changing project counts mid-session), a raw before/after count is meaningless. Instead the ORIGINAL plugins were extracted from commit 0050bd03cb (session-start HEAD) into the ticket folder and both versions were run back-to-back against the SAME filesystem via a purpose-built harness that drives the real createNodesV2 functions:
- 254 vs 254 projects, IDENTICAL project name/root set.
- ZERO target-set changes (leveled-test synthesis is a no-op today: all 224 test-bearing projects already declare all 3 levels — it exists to unblock the M11 sweep).
- EXACTLY 45 semantic deltas, all `cwd` additions: 44 on `workspace` (root ".", where cwd "." is identical to nx's workspaceRoot default — a true no-op) and 1 genuine latent-bug fix on `@semio-tech/compose-rs::setup`, which previously ran the workspace-root script instead of its own.
- Move isolation: harness output BYTE-IDENTICAL before vs after the .mjs relocation, and again before vs after the nx.json hygiene edits.
- nx.json validated as parseable JSON after every edit; both plugin paths resolve, import cleanly and expose `createNodesV2` with correct names via nx's own resolution semantics.

GRAPH HEALTH: the ENOENT abort from our plugin is GONE — it no longer appears in nx output at all, so graph health is strictly improved versus the session-start baseline. The graph still does not fully resolve, blocked solely by the EXTERNAL `os-hub` duplicate; verified that os-hub is the ONLY duplicate name in the workspace (253 unique names across 254 entries), so the graph resolves as soon as that agent deletes `🌎️hub/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust`. Waited ~7 min for it; it is still mid-flight. No revert was warranted at any point — every delta was traced to a specific external agent or to an intended, verified change.

Constraints honored: no git-modifying commands (read-only git show/log only), no worktrees, no background Bash for verification, root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/registry output/.vscode/launch.json/root package.json workspaces/.storybook/.dependency-cruiser.cjs/plugin dirs and the M1 taxonomy+discovery files all untouched. Scratch files retained in the ticket folder.

FOLLOW-UPS for the orchestrator: (a) nx's lossy-UTF8 walker bug still degrades nx's own @nx/js dependency creation on deep emoji paths — worth an upstream report or an nx pin/patch decision; (b) M11's project.json simplification sweep is now unblocked and can delete the 3 leveled test targets plus redundant cwd/executor keys from 224+ files; (c) nx.json is now frozen per the plan's ownership table — later edits are registrar-only.
